scope: Only the planned single-double GPU sorting overload and existing float/byte/double-sigma copy controls. No J state, PDE, actual neighbor division, solver, GPU public entry or physical/default-OFF solver acceptance.
contract: actual a2[p]=a[p<pini?p:sortpart[p]] for p<np; JCellDivGpu effective pini is 0 for DivideFull and NpbFinal otherwise; no writes at p>=np. Input/output aliasing is not admitted or tested.
fixture_access: A normal derived JCellDivGpu fixture configures protected Nptot/NpbFinal/DivideFull/SortPart only. It owns its uploaded device map, frees and detaches SortPart before the base destructor; no external map owner can double-free it. No private-access macro. It does not call Divide or claim a generated cell permutation; maps are independently constructed native in-range permutations.

prefixes: DivideFull=true with deliberately nonzero NpbFinal where possible, effective0
permutations: prefix and tail independently one-position rotated
matrix.notes: DIVBSIZE remains256; np257 exercises the next CUDA block. Requested127/128/129 cases are retained. Zero-size calls must leave the entire guard-only destination unchanged. Partial-sort maps independently permute prefix and tail within their own ranges, while expected output for p<pini remains source[p]. The nonidentity prefix makes an incorrectly ignored pini detectable rather than vacuously passing. Every entire map remains an in-range native permutation.

bit_patterns: Finite doubles/floats include positive/negative zero, smallest subnormal, minimum normal, adjacent representable values near1 (double differences lost by float conversion), large finite positive/negative values and distinct indexed values. No arithmetic tolerance: complete source and target including guard slots are byte-compared; original map and its poison tail must remain unchanged.
gates: all first-np destination/prefix bytes exactly expected
Debug compute-sanitizer memcheck error-exit99 and zero-error summary
Release same exact component matrix after Debug passed
sequence_one_explicit_action_at_a_time: FreezeBaseline before the root four-file source patch: copy actual old GPU Debug/Release canonical binaries plus all DLL/config and four old source files; seal current all-source identities. These old binaries are not claimed to have been built from the newer CPU/shared-class source.
Root applies exactly the four overload source edits after CPU checkpoint; no edits are performed by the driver.

Build Debug: allow those four expected original-source changes, freeze the four NEW source snapshots and all current source identities before a full authoritative GPU Rebuild. Use isolated tests output, no-space Temp IntDir; canonical GPU programs/server packages must remain byte-unchanged. Link fixture against every active authoritative project object except main, not a replacement CUDA implementation.
Run Debug: actual copy component under compute-sanitizer only, not a solver.
Build Release only after sealed Debug576/memcheck passed; distinct isolated output/IntDir and full authoritative Rebuild.
Run Release: direct copy component only. Native GPU default-OFF solver regression is a separate later gate.
commands: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File support/upl_gpu_sort_r1.ps1 -Mode FreezeBaseline|Build|Run -Configuration Debug|Release -ProductionBuildConfirmed -ExecutionAuthorized; select one action/configuration, no automatic sequence
build_environment: VS/DualSPHysics5Re.sln + vcxproj authoritative; MSVCv14314.36.32532; CUDA_PATH_V11_7; original project compute86/sm86/use_fast_math preserved; no-space IntDir is required by the known nvcc nested-path quoting failure. OutDir is always under tests/outputs and PostBuildEvent is disabled.
ownership: Fresh paths only; no retry, overwrite, cleanup, worker, notifier, solver or Git operation. Preserve failed compiler/memcheck logs and all snapshots. Root selects each later action only after source/recipe review.
